notes.note: Reviewed the mobile Inbox focus change: Search focuses its newly mounted field in the layout commit, without a delayed animation-frame callback that can steal a subsequent row selection. The regression test holds scheduled frames, checks immediate field focus, then verifies row focus and Enter activation; it failed against the prior implementation and passes with the fix (16 controller tests, 14.33 seconds). The browser case now asserts Search/latest-row focus, bounds the initial request premise, and starts waiting for the deliberately held response only when releasing it. It retains stale-result, URL, focus, snooze, dismissal and touch-target assertions; the browser recheck is recorded separately. Shared Inbox ownership, layout and authority policy remain unchanged.
